landing.heroLine: Stage, image, and voice — between Mexico and Europe.
landing.bio: Sophie Gomez builds a trajectory across stage, film, and image. Like a launch: precision, silence, impact. Between Mexico and Europe, she inhabits every frame — actress, model, voice.

actrice.title: Actress
actrice.bio: Trained in classical and contemporary stage work, Sophie is building a path across auteur film, chamber theatre, and independent audiovisual storytelling. She seeks roles where silence, body, and presence matter as much as dialogue.

modelo.title: Model
modelo.bio: A versatile image across editorial and commercial work: Sophie treats light, line, and posture as a visual language. Each series explores a register — fashion, beauty, campaign — with the same aesthetic rigour.

silverPresence.title: Silver Presence
silverPresence.bio: Silver Presence is Sophie's communication project: a space dedicated to voice, presence, and narrative. Through videos and editorial content, she explores how image and speech are built.

pressKit.title: Press kit
pressKit.bio: Press resources: biography, high-definition photos, and credits for media and casting.
